# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 549 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [CAMEL](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/camel.html): CAMEL, one of the first multi-agent frameworks, for building role-playing agents and large agent societies.
- [Galileo Agent Leaderboard](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/galileo-agent-leaderboard.html): Galileo's leaderboard that ranks how well LLMs perform as agents on tool use and multi-step tasks.
- [TEN Framework](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/ten-framework.html): Open-source framework for real-time multimodal voice agents, including the TEN Agent demo.
- [AgentFlow](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/agentflow.html): Stanford's trainable agentic system where planner, executor, verifier and generator modules coordinate, with a Hugging Face demo.
- [IBM CUGA](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/ibm-cuga.html): IBM Research's configurable generalist agent (CUGA) for enterprise web and API tasks, with a live demo on Hugging Face Spaces.
- [Querri](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/querri.html): AI data analyst that cleans scattered data and answers questions in plain English.
- [Crewdle](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/crewdle.html): Hire autonomous agents and teams for support, sales, bookkeeping and research, paid per task.
- [Coldtea](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/coldtea.html): Agents that test every pull request on real devices, watch production and file issues before users hit them.
- [CoChat](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/cochat.html): AI research agents that gather verified sources and organize findings.
- [Clara AI SDR](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/clara-ai-sdr.html): Face-to-face video AI SDR that talks to website visitors, qualifies leads and books meetings.
